headline: Power Backup Report for Smith County
summary: Smith County has a high outlook. It sees a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In one big storm 56% of homes in the county lost power. In another 33% of homes in the county lost power. Homes in Smith County with electric heat may need backup power. One Core lasts about 15 hours on one Core in January. One Core lasts about 31 hours on one Core in November. Two Cores last about 30 hours on two Cores in January. The suggested number of Cores is 2 Cores. This covers 79% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
